2000	But through man's devekut with the Infinite, where there is no change of essence, since
2001	there it is a simple will.
2002	What does "simple" mean?
2003	That it has no levels within it, that it is a whole, a complete thing.
2004	And afterwards a reshimo remains from that unity, and afterwards it becomes the aspect of
2005	"and returns."
2006	That is, it returns to its own essential will.
2007	But what?
2008	It returns with a charge, with the correction that it made.
2009	Then, at least, it shows it to know that all is good and all is one.
2010	So I need both of these powers: on one hand I need the expansion from the essential will,
2011	that is, to be in order to bestow, which is the form of the Infinite, blessed be He, from our standpoint,
2012	in the highest form there is.
2013	Therefore the Infinite's intention also wanted, it is written that it wanted to make the Torah equal
2014	to His essence. Equal to what of His essence?
2015	It has no grasp of His essence, but rather the intention wanted a form of bestowal as the Infinite appears to it.
2016	So through our
2017	wanting the power of the infinite bestowal, but on the other hand
2018	we need this power inside the desire to receive, not outside the desire to receive, so
2019	we need both of these powers, both the judgment and the mercy, both HaVaYaH and Elokim.
2020	And this is truly a wonder; therefore the exiles don't understand this: how can it be that you have a longing,
2021	a desire, but truly to bestow?
2022	How can there be a middle line?
2023	Moments are either left or right; I don't understand what a middle is.
2024	Because truly it is a miracle, a wonder, something that is not logical.
2025	But it is a matter of the masach, and there is much to say about it; it is a very deep
2026	subject.
2027	Deeper than the seas.
2028	But in short, we need both the power of "something" and the power of "nothing."
2029	Both the power of awe and complete self-nullification, but also the power of love.
2030	We keep this right now in separate vessels.
2031	In the future to come, it will be in one vessel, at one time, in one place, and so on.
2032	Right now we work on it in parts.
2033	But each time a reshimo remains from this part.
2034	And then this reshimo...
2035	More and more, slowly, we will have a complete
2036	picture. And this is what Moshe said to his generation: "You were shown to know that HaShem is the Elokim,"
2037	because Moshe is the aspect of "nothing," and his generation, who cleaved to him, deserved to know.
2038	But who among us even reaches the aspect of "nothing"?
2039	Who even thinks about it?
